description.value:
Frequency twice per scene

Traits Long-Shadow

You may use The Long View twice per scene instead of once. In addition, when you use it, one other Hollowbound within 30 feet who can see you may ask a question of their own as part of the same use, without spending a use of their own. Both questions are put to your spirit, and both answers are given to both of you.

cinderfall.incomplete: The frequency-doubling clause needs "The Long View" (a Long-Shadow covenant ability) to exist as its own card with a trackable frequency -- it has none; it is flavor text only inside long-shadow-covenant.json's description, itself SKIP for the same reason. This grants a different creature use of, or a piggyback on, this actor's own resource/ability. No selector or rule element exists anywhere in pf2e-source for letting a different creature use this actor's own class feature for free -- confirmed corpus-wide this pass.
